attributes.name: Thmei
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, you are dealt 1d4 Poison damage; if this damage is not reduced to 0, suffer the scourge Curse of the Sphinx. Then shuffle Thmei into a random open location.

If defeated, draw the loot Golden Serpent Armband from the box. Then you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

corrections.corrected_text: On the henchman Thmei, change "draw the loot Armband of the Golden Serpent from the box" to "draw the loot Golden Serpent Armband from the box".
corrections.issue: I defeated Thmei, and now I'm supposed to draw the loot Armband of the Golden Serpent, but I can't find it.
